en.title: Get Substring
en.description:
In a string containing only 0/1, find a substring with exactly k 1s; first minimize the length, and among equal lengths take the lexicographically smallest. The statement guarantees an answer exists.

See the statement and review notes for the problem source and the input protocol added by this site.
en.input: The first line is the binary string s; the second line is k. Source range: 1≤k≤|s|≤1000, and s contains at least k 1s.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the accompanying notes for the detailed approach.
hints: Enumerate every window of k consecutive 1s, keep only the shortest candidate from the window's first 1 to its k-th 1, then take the minimum by length and lexicographic order.
